post.description: POSTed as JSON for every subscribed event (product.published, product.updated, product.price_changed, product.availability_changed, product.unpublished, product.deleted, webhook.test). Verify X-REA-Signature: v1=hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, timestamp + "." + raw body)); during a secret rotation two v1 values are sent. Answer 2xx within the timeout; anything else is retried with exponential backoff. Deduplicate on the event id.

parameters.description: Event ID, identical across retries and redeliveries

parameters.description: Delivery ID (a redelivery has a new one)
parameters.name: X-REA-Delivery-Id

parameters.description: Unix seconds when the request was signed; reject old timestamps
parameters.name: X-REA-Timestamp
